name: @vismay/html-stories
description: Agent-authored, self-contained HTML stories: storage, metadata extraction, site chrome, the agent brief (per app: vizmaya-fyi, footshorts; per story format: scroll, book, board, deck; a vizmaya brief can carry a randomizer spin), the hosted format runtimes (formats/), and the shared serve/publish/brief route handlers.
